name: Doman Building Materials Group Ltd.
summary: Doman Building Materials Group Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale distribution of building materials and home renovation products in the United States and Canada. The company offers treated wood; siding and trim; decking and railing; engineered wood products; underlayment; caulking, adhesive & fasteners; Interior Finishing; Specialty Industrial Products; roofing products; insulation and wrap products; and lumber and plywood products. It is also involved in pressure treating activities, as well as timber ownership and management of private timberlands and forest licenses; and provides other value-add services.
